mysql --batch --raw --column-names --default-character-set=utf8mb4 --host gateway06.us-east-1.prod.aws.tidbcloud.com --port 4000 --user 36TVxk1pStcAATK.07f148c4450d --database giA7FxHni3yvayrRDCTkdD --execute 
-- Fix bucket name trong site_settings (yukvix.manus.space -> media.yukvix.com)
UPDATE site_settings SET `value` = 'media.yukvix.com' WHERE `key` = 'wasabi.bucket';

-- Migrate media_items: thay https://media.yukvix.com/ -> https://s3.ap-southeast-1.wasabisys.com/media.yukvix.com/
UPDATE media_items 
SET thumbUrl = REPLACE(thumbUrl, 'https://media.yukvix.com/', 'https://s3.ap-southeast-1.wasabisys.com/media.yukvix.com/')
WHERE thumbUrl LIKE 'https://media.yukvix.com/%';

UPDATE media_items 
SET webpUrl = REPLACE(webpUrl, 'https://media.yukvix.com/', 'https://s3.ap-southeast-1.wasabisys.com/media.yukvix.com/')
WHERE webpUrl LIKE 'https://media.yukvix.com/%';

UPDATE media_items 
SET originalUrl = REPLACE(originalUrl, 'https://media.yukvix.com/', 'https://s3.ap-southeast-1.wasabisys.com/media.yukvix.com/')
WHERE originalUrl LIKE 'https://media.yukvix.com/%';

-- Migrate photos table cũng cần fix
UPDATE photos 
SET thumbUrl = REPLACE(thumbUrl, 'https://media.yukvix.com/', 'https://s3.ap-southeast-1.wasabisys.com/media.yukvix.com/')
WHERE thumbUrl LIKE 'https://media.yukvix.com/%';

UPDATE photos 
SET webpUrl = REPLACE(webpUrl, 'https://media.yukvix.com/', 'https://s3.ap-southeast-1.wasabisys.com/media.yukvix.com/')
WHERE webpUrl LIKE 'https://media.yukvix.com/%';

UPDATE photos 
SET originalUrl = REPLACE(originalUrl, 'https://media.yukvix.com/', 'https://s3.ap-southeast-1.wasabisys.com/media.yukvix.com/')
WHERE originalUrl LIKE 'https://media.yukvix.com/%';

-- Fix logo/favicon trong site_settings
UPDATE site_settings 
SET `value` = REPLACE(`value`, 'https://media.yukvix.com/', 'https://s3.ap-southeast-1.wasabisys.com/media.yukvix.com/')
WHERE `value` LIKE 'https://media.yukvix.com/%';
